headline: Weathered Expanse Heaviest; Fisherman's Row Swings Back to Colonials
war_summary: The heaviest file of the day remains Weathered Expanse, where twenty-one events have been logged in six hours and six in the last two; Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk bear the brunt, Warden colours now over three of nine squares against six Colonial. Fisherman's Row has swung back the other way, its twelve events in two hours set about Eidolo, Black Well and Dankana Post, leaving the ledger at seven Colonial to two Warden. Callahan's Passage stays brisk, eighteen events in six hours though only three in the last two, The Crumbling Passage still the hinge, Wardens holding eight squares there to two. Stlican Shelf files six events in two hours at Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, the line split four Warden to five Colonial. Mooring County and Stema Landing remain unsettled, Wiccwalk and Gravekeeper's Holdfast in the one, The Flair and The Wane in the other at this hour. Heavy casualty rolls continue at Linn Mercy and Nevish Line without any shift of colours, and Palantine Berm has gone quiet. Colonials retain the great majority of the map, Warden colours flying over fifteen whole regions.
